propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion-verifier runs exhaust the bounded request budget with zero incrementally banked criterion verdicts, violating the documented incremental-banking contract.
Pydantic AI executes model response tool batches concurrently, allowing concurrent repository calls to defeat prompt-only serialization directives and defer all record calls until budget exhaustion.

The completion-only policy wrapper at CompletionAgentStep atomically governs one repository action per response, counts evidence responses per criterion, and invokes provisional met=false banking on the third evidence response if still unbanked.
System-authority finite-loop guidance in the primary and successor prompts directives and data-only manifest replace subjective untrusted prompt instructions to enforce bounded banking.

The wrapped completion policy is composed between memo and runaway-guard layers, rejects concurrent same-response tool calls, and guarantees at least one bank entry before exhaustion for each criterion.
